notes: v1.0.30 — CHUNK STREAMING REBUILD: async server-chunk decode + never-stuck pipeline. The multiplayer chunk path was the worst jank case: vanilla decodes every incoming server chunk packet ON the game thread, so a join burst or server resend stalls the client. Now: packet decode moves to a bounded worker pool (1-3 threads by preset, cap 96, farthest dropped on saturation, never CallerRuns), finished chunks apply nearest-first 12/tick so you are playable almost instantly after joining and the rest streams in progressively. Last-wins dedup covers reconnect/resync; world-leave flushes everything in flight. Local scenarios at the same standard: cancellable mesh compiles (a stale mesh queued for a chunk that left the loaded area is skipped with vanilla CANCELLED semantics) so the queue never falls behind during fast movement. Everything behind the SafetyGate (falls back to vanilla on repeated failures, stands down with Sodium/AFK). PROF logs pipe backlog /decodes, overlay shows a DQ chip under backlog, CHUNKPIPE logs drops + 60s summary. New setting 'Async Chunk Decode' (ON default): launcher Settings -> Performance + in-game K menu, seeded per-tier by the RPE. FPS Boost bundled is now 1.0.9 (auto-upgrades profiles). Zero gameplay changes — only how chunk work is scheduled.
